name: Submerged Gallery
source:
Explore a virtual gallery of submechanophobia in a retro computing environment. Although this isn't really a "game", there are two endings. The goal is to simply take your time enjoying experiencing the creepy images, captions, and music (feat. the retro PC MT-32)! This was created for the [url=https://itch.io/jam/hps1sos]Haunted PS1 Summer of Shivers Jam (Summer Jam 2021)[/url].

[From [url=https://eldritchrenaissancecake.itch.io/submerged-gallery]itch.io[/url]]
